fields.title: Cell Type
fields.help:
Mesh element shape used to fill this region.
Triangle: Flexible unstructured cells.
Quad: Channelized quadrilateral cells.
Cartesian: Axis-aligned rectangular grid.
Empty: Blank region, no cells.

fields.title: Constant Size
fields.help: Target face length for the primary dimension of the region

fields.title: Secondary Constant Size
fields.help: Target face length for the secondary dimension of the region. For triangles, controls the minimum allowable cell size.

fields.title: Rotation
fields.help: Rotation of the cartesian cells, in degrees counter clockwise from North

fields.title: Cell Stretching Rate
fields.help: Maximum ratio of adjacent cell sizes. Controls how quickly cells can grow or shrink across the region. A value of 1 means uniform sizing.

fields.title: Curved Faces
fields.help: Interior quad and 1D faces will have curved faces following the overal patch curvature.

fields.title: Laplace Resolution
fields.help: Increase/decrease resolution of curved faces (via resolution of underlying TIN.) Value is the approximate number of TIN edges per quad face

fields.title: Quad/Triangle Tolerance
fields.help: Value between 0 and 1 (Default 1). Controls when quad regions insert triangles to transition cell-size. Lower values will insert more triangles to hit the target cell-size.

fields.title: Simple Cut/Fill Properties
fields.help: Property set this feature cuts or fills to. Blank means none

fields.title: Mode
fields.help: Whether the feature fills up from the profile or cuts down into the terrain

fields.title: Left Width
fields.help: Distance the left side extends away from the top

fields.title: Right Width
